about.short: Godavari Roofing Industries is a leading provider of high-quality roofing solutions, committed to excellence, structural safety, and customer satisfaction across Andhra Pradesh and South India.
about.mission: To provide a seamless and professional roofing and structural steel experience that places customer satisfaction, weatherproofing performance, and long-term durability at the center of every project.
about.vision: To elevate the architectural standard of residential, commercial, and industrial roofing through innovative materials, precision craftsmanship, and sustainable practices.

products.name: JSW Indradhanush+ Color Coated Sheets
products.description: Advanced multi-layer protected color coated steel sheets offering superior corrosion resistance, high solar reflectance, and vibrant long-lasting aesthetic appeal.

products.name: Mangalore Tile Profile Roofing Sheets
products.description: Combines the traditional elegance of clay roof tiles with the high structural strength and lightweight advantage of modern prepainted metal sheets.

products.name: C & Z Galvanized Purlins
products.description: High-tensile cold-formed steel C and Z purlins designed for optimal roof structural framing, providing maximum support with reduced overall steel weight.

products.name: Multiwall Polycarbonate Skylight Sheets
products.description: Ultra-durable, UV-stabilized clear and tinted polycarbonate sheets designed for natural daylighting in industrial sheds, verandas, and skylights.

products.name: Stainless Steel Wind-Driven Turbo Ventilators
products.description: Eco-friendly, zero-electricity rooftop exhaust ventilators that continuously draw out hot air, fumes, and humidity from warehouses and factories.

products.name: PPGL & Galvalume Coils
products.description: Premium grade Pre-Painted Galvalume (PPGL) and Bare Galvalume steel coils manufactured by JSW Steel for roll-forming and industrial cladding.

services.name: Residential Roofing Solutions
services.short: Complete home roofing installations, villa shed additions, and architectural tile profile roofing tailored for longevity and curb appeal.
services.details: We transform residential spaces with durable, insulated, and aesthetically pleasing roofing systems engineered to withstand intense tropical heat and heavy monsoon rain.

services.name: Commercial & PEB Shed Solutions
services.short: Turnkey Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) roofs, factory sheds, agricultural godowns, and warehouse structural steel framing.
services.details: Custom engineered industrial roofing projects delivered on tight schedules with zero compromise on wind-load safety and structural integrity.

services.name: Roof Renovation & Waterproof Coating
services.short: Replacing old asbestos/corrosion sheets, applying elastomeric waterproof coatings, and retrofitting existing roof structures.
services.details: Breathe new life into aging roofs with non-disruptive sheet replacement, leak proofing, and heat-reflective roof coatings.

services.name: Skylight & Ventilation Systems
services.short: Integration of polycarbonate skylight strips and wind-driven turbo ventilators for natural lighting and temperature control.
services.details: Reduce energy bills by up to 30% by combining high-transmission daylighting sheets with self-driven roof exhaust fans.

installationSteps.title: Site Inspection & Digital Measurement
installationSteps.desc: Laser measurement of span, slope gradient, wall anchor points, and structural load analysis.

installationSteps.title: Design & Material Selection
installationSteps.desc: Custom selection of JSW sheet profiles, gauge thickness, color finish, and purlin spacing.

installationSteps.title: Framework & Purlin Structure
installationSteps.desc: Erection of high-strength C/Z galvanized purlins and heavy-duty steel rafters with precision welding.

installationSteps.title: Underlayment & Waterproof Layer
installationSteps.desc: Laying anti-condensation thermal insulation felt and leak-barrier membrane.

installationSteps.title: Sheet Installation & Interlock
installationSteps.desc: Precision sliding and lap-interlocking of color coated sheets with crest sealing.

installationSteps.title: Fasteners, Flashing & Ridge Capping
installationSteps.desc: Securing with EPDM washer self-drilling screws, installing custom ridge caps and gutter downspouts.

installationSteps.title: Final Quality Check & Handover
installationSteps.desc: Water spray leak testing, alignment inspection, cleanup, and issuance of warranty certificate.

faqs.q: What makes JSW Indradhanush+ color coated sheets superior?
faqs.a: JSW Indradhanush+ sheets use advanced zinc-aluminum alloy coating with UV-resistant paint technology, ensuring up to 3x longer life against rust compared to ordinary GI sheets.

faqs.q: Do you provide installation services along with material supply?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer complete turnkey services including structural purlin fabrication, sheet supply, professional installation, and post-installation maintenance.

faqs.q: How long does a typical residential metal roof installation take?
faqs.a: Most residential roofs (1,000 to 3,000 sq. ft.) are fabricated and fully installed within 3 to 5 working days depending on structural design complexity.

faqs.q: Can polycarbonate sheets withstand extreme hail and wind?
faqs.a: Yes, high-grade polycarbonate sheets are up to 200 times stronger than glass and engineered to withstand high wind velocity and heavy impacts.
